title: Library Wing (Tyr's Hand)
wikitext:
[[Image:Library Wing2.jpg|thumb|The Tyr's Hand Abbey Library Wing]]

The '''Library Wing''' of [[Tyr's Hand Abbey]], located in [[Tyr's Hand]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], is home to numerous members of the [[Scarlet Crusade]] who seek knowledge and enlightenment in the tomes of religious propaganda and insanity that can be found here. It is situated south of the [[Main Hall (Tyr's Hand)|Main Hall]], and the [[Hall of Arms (Tyr's Hand)|Hall of Arms]] lies on the opposite side of the abbey.
